# WO-633: Wizard finish step says "Consent has not been given" after the profile was already saved
Status: GO (immediate)
Vendor: claude
Agent: wizard-packager, then qa-security (review)
Kind: wizard
Tier: max
Severity: HIGH
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.3.2
Source: field report docs/feedback/2026-11-13-windows-family-test.md (F4). Related: strict xfail from WO-240 (commit 969dbb4b) for server.py:88.
Boundary: the consent gate stays fail-closed. Fix the flow, never loosen consent_ok.

## Task
1. Reproduce: POST /wizard/finish twice (double-click, page re-post, back + Finish), and with a slow `_default_finish` (scheduler install takes seconds on Windows). Confirm the second POST hits a fresh draft and `SaveError("Consent has not been given.")` (`src/freemyid/wizard/draft.py:520`) after the first already saved.
2. Make finish idempotent: a repeat finish after a successful save goes to the dashboard with the "created" message, not an error. Disable the Finish button on submit and show "Saving..." (plain words). Run the scheduler install and first run off the request path so the answer comes back at once; report a scheduler failure on the dashboard instead.
3. Fix `_consent_problem` (`src/freemyid/wizard/server.py:86-89`) to pass the store, so an authorized-agent profile with its document is not shown as a consent problem. Turn the WO-240 strict xfail into a passing test.
4. Any consent message the person sees says what to do next, in plain words.

## Acceptance
- New tests: double finish POST, finish while the scheduler stub sleeps, authorized-agent dashboard with a stored document. Fake people only.
- `.venv/bin/pytest -q`, `ruff check src tests`, `mypy src` pass; counts recorded.
- qa-security review: consent gate still refuses every case it refused before.
